prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1326; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred while our client was making a left turn and was struck by another vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is currently receiving medical care.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this claim, including requests for statements, scheduling, and settlement discussions, must be directed exclusively to this office. Please do not contact our client directly.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the liability policy covering the at-fault driver, including declarations pages, and disclose the applicable bodily injury policy limits in writing within fourteen days of receipt of this letter.

We further demand that your company preserve all evidence relating to this matter. This includes photographs, recorded statements, claim file materials, vehicle data, telematics information, and any other documentation in your possession, custody, or control. Failure to preserve such evidence may result in sanctions in any subsequent litigation.
